source_evidence: If shareholder requests for repurchase exceed the amount of outstanding shares eligible for repurchase during a repurchase offer, repurchase is generally done on a pro rata basis.
question: What may happen if shareholders request more shares to be repurchased than an interval fund is offering to buy back?
answer: The fund generally repurchases shares on a pro rata basis, so you may be able to sell only part of the number of shares you requested.
